title: Latest OpenAI web search tool raises an error caused by hardcoded values in langchain-core
body:
### Checked other resources

- [x] This is a bug, not a usage question. For questions, please use the LangChain Forum (https://forum.langchain.com/).
- [x] I added a clear and descriptive title that summarizes this issue.
- [x] I used the GitHub search to find a similar question and didn't find it.
- [x] I am sure that this is a bug in LangChain rather than my code.
- [x] The bug is not resolved by updating to the latest stable version of LangChain (or the specific integration package).
- [x] I read what a minimal reproducible example is (https://stackoverflow.com/help/minimal-reproducible-example).
- [x] I posted a self-contained, minimal, reproducible example. A maintainer can copy it and run it AS IS.

### Example Code

The following code:

```python
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI

llm = ChatOpenAI(model='gpt-5')
bound_llm = llm.bind_tools([{'type': 'web_search'}])
bound_llm.invoke('Hi')
```

Which returns:
```python
ValueError: Unsupported function
{'type': 'web_search'}
```

```
ValueError: Unsupported function

{'type': 'web_search'}

Functions must be passed in as Dict, pydantic.BaseModel, or Callable. If they're a dict they must either be in OpenAI function format or valid JSON schema with top-level 'title' and 'description' keys.
```

### Description

Note that `web_search` is the newer version of `web_search_preview` and is a supported function according to OpenAI:
https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/tools-web-search?api-mode=responses

The check that fails is this line where the accepted values are hardcoded:

In this file:
https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain/blob/1fe2c4084b1c6338d2aee23da3cbc936cd5f7c8a/libs/core/langchain_core/utils/function_calling.py#L584

I believe it should accept `web_search` as an accepted value.

linked_prs.title: feat(core): add `web_search` in OpenAI tools list
linked_prs.body:
**Description:** The new `web_search` tool is added in the OpenAI tools list. Documentation: https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/tools-web-search?api-mode=responses


**Issue:** Fixes #32735

ai_judgment.response: Yes. The issue involves tool invocation failures, specifically the inability to bind and invoke the `web_search` tool due to hardcoded values in the LangChain core. This aligns with the "Misuse tool interfaces" sub-category under tool-related issues in the agent issue taxonomy.
